Margins & costs: Because we are targeting 50% utilization, that ideally means we are moving up from 8,000 to, let's say by 10,000, I mean, at 80% capacity utilization, we'll be at 6 - 6,500, right, for this year.
And, we talk about this, there has been a 7-8% increase in the pricing for a period of time, because there has been an increase in all the raw material prices.
So, we had a 10% gross margin cut, and about 2%, you know, and 200 basis points in the net margin, which got wiped off because of the aluminum increase.
